Muscle Lab

63 muscles on a 3D body, from the head and eye down to the lower leg. Drag to turn the body, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or two fingers to move it.

Explore labels every muscle like a diagram; tap one for its origin, insertion and action. Find it gives a name and you tap the muscle. Name it highlights a muscle and you type it, write it with a pen, or pick from a word bank. Flashcards and O · I · A drill the rest.

Peel removes the surface or middle layers to reach deep muscles. Your scores stay in this browser.

3D anatomy from BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY-SA 2.1 JP. The six eye muscles are modeled for this page. Runs on your device.
